topic.title: Assets of Community Value / Community Right to Bid
topic.source_contract: asset identity and qualifying use, eligible nomination, listing decision and review, register status, disposal notification, moratorium periods, community bid, transaction and continued community-use evidence

scope_guards: A community nomination is not an ACV listing.
Listing is not a planning designation or ownership transfer.
An ACV listing does not require the owner to sell.
A moratorium is not a right of first refusal.
A community expression of interest is not a funded bid.
A submitted bid is not a completed acquisition.
Acquisition is not treated as continued community operation.
No score or promotion is written without exact listing, disposal, bid, transaction and operation evidence.
